subject.title: fix(tavily): forward the execution abort signal to web search HTTP requests

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104216 own the shared `runWebSearch` parent-abort fallback change, leaving this PR to carry only Tavily-specific propagation?
rationale: Both branches contain the same shared-runtime behavior, but only the SearXNG branch currently has sufficient real held-request proof; choosing one owner avoids duplicate conflict resolution and future drift.

options.title: Use the SearXNG PR as canonical
options.body: Land the shared runtime hunk through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104216 and rebase this PR to its Tavily-specific changes.

options.title: Keep the shared hunk here
options.body: Make this PR the shared-runtime owner and require equivalent real fallback and request-closure proof before landing it ahead of the sibling branch.

recommendation.title: Use the SearXNG PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Land the shared runtime hunk through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104216 and rebase this PR to its Tavily-specific changes.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant current Tavily and shared-runtime paths originate in their commit history, making them the strongest available routing candidate for ownership selection.
